description.zh: 是否全量发布。该字段仅当 PublishType设置为 region 时生效。
description.en: Specifies whether to fully release the version. This parameter takes effect only when PublishType is set to region.
The release percentage. Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 100.

description.zh:
发布的环境，取值如下：

- **prod**: 生产环境。
- **staging**：预发环境。
description.en:
The environment to which you want to release the version. Valid values:

- prod: the production environment.

- staging: the staging environment.

description.zh:
发布类型，支持如下两种：
- **percentage**：按照百分比发布。

- **region**：按照区域发布。

若不填写，默认使用百分比发布。
description.en:
Specifies how the version is released. Valid values:

- percentage: releases the version by percentage.

- region: releases the version by region.

If you do not specify this parameter, the version is released by percentage by default.
The regions to which the version is released.
The remarks. This parameter is empty by default.

description.zh:
开始进行发布的时间，不写则默认为当前时间。

日期格式按照ISO8601表示法，并使用UTC+0时间，格式为yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ。
description.en:
The time when the application version starts to be released. If you do not specify this parameter, the current time is used by default.

Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the yyyy-MM-ddTHH:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC.

title.zh: 发布边缘容器的指定版本

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa publish-edge-container-app-version --app-id app-880688675783790000 --version-id ver-879626371616510000 --publish-env prod --percentage 100 --start-time 2023-06-05T16:00:00Z --remarks test_publish_app --publish-type percentage --regions jiangsu --full-release true --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa PublishEdgeContainerAppVersion --region cn-hangzhou --VersionId 'ver-879626371616510000' --AppId 'app-880688675783790000' --Percentage 100 --Remarks test_publish_app --StartTime '2023-06-05T16:00:00Z' --FullRelease true --Regions '["jiangsu"]' --PublishEnv prod --PublishType percentage
